content:
Warrior of the battlefield, king of the arena,
how do you show your strength, when there is nobody to fight?
Your power and your skills, your crowning glory lies in waste,
when you are in a world that does not have your sight.

To your loved ones, you submit, never raise your voice,
if there is a quarrel, you sort it out, never aggravate,
this is your weakness, you hurt the hard, you yield to the soft,
this is your destiny, strength and weakness, in this world you create!
